🇮🇹 🇮🇱 🇵🇸 ⚡️ — Italy's parliament has passed a controversial antisemitism law adopting the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA) definition of antisemitism, prompting concerns that it could restrict criticism of Israel and advocacy for Palestinian rights. The legislation was approved by 147 votes to 93 and incorporates the IHRA definition, which includes examples relating to criticism of Israel. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's governing coalition rejected concerns over freedom of expression, arguing that legitimate political criticism would remain protected. @IntelSlava

🌍 Iranian Mission in Vienna: Aggression cannot be erased by resolutions 📌 London, IRNA – Iranian Permanent Mission to International Organizations in Vienna criticized the legal and technical foundations of the International Atomic Energy Agency's reports on Iran, calling on the IAEA Board of Governors to address the consequences of military attacks against the country's nuclear facilities. The Iranian mission stated that the IAEA has based its reports on Iran on resolutions adopted by the Board of Governors that are technically and legally flawed, were adopted through the abuse of decision-making procedures, and contain findings that exceed the Agency's statutory mandate. ​ Referring to remarks by IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi, the mission emphasized that, as Grossi himself acknowledged, attacks on Iran's safeguarded nuclear facilities have created unprecedented circumstances, disrupted inspection activities, and forced the Agency to withdraw its inspectors. ​ The mission stressed that these circumstances also require Iran's security concerns to be taken into account. ​ "The United States removed the aggression from biased resolutions, but its consequences cannot be erased from reality. Facts do not disappear simply because politics demands it," the mission stated. ​ In another part of its message, the Iranian mission emphasized that returning to normal conditions requires addressing the factors responsible for creating the current situation. ​ "Normal safeguards implementation cannot and will not resume under abnormal circumstances," it stressed. ​ The mission concluded by emphasizing that the IAEA Board of Governors must address the root causes of the current situation. ​ However, it added that this is an impossible task because the Board includes the aggressor among its members. 📲 @Irna_en ​
